resolution_rule: For every external $ref in a registered schema, split the reference at the first #. Resolve the nonempty resource component only by exact filename lookup in resources; load exactly that path below base_directory; require the loaded document's $id to byte-equal resources[filename].id; then resolve the fragment within that document. Network retrieval, current-working-directory fallback, basename guessing, duplicate IDs, unregistered schema files, and redirects are forbidden.
identity_rule: Every *.schema.json file below base_directory appears exactly once. Filenames and $id values are byte-exact, unique, and immutable after ratification.

sha256_placeholder_policy.meaning: Null is a proposal-time placeholder, never a runtime wildcard.
sha256_placeholder_policy.seal: The ratified protocol/change manifest seals the exact bytes of this registry and every registered schema. During post-ratification CPU implementation, P1CB01 computes each exact-file SHA-256, writes the resolved executable lock, and rejects any mismatch before DEV dispatch.
sha256_placeholder_policy.runtime_requirement: A resource is resolvable only when its computed lowercase SHA-256 equals the value sealed in the resolved executable lock; null is forbidden after P1CB01.
